title: Nano Banana joins the image API
summary:
A model-heavy day: Nano Banana image generation, search-grounded Gemini, DeepSeek V3.1, and a language tutor.

Added `nanobanana` for text-to-image generation and image edits using one or more reference image URLs. A follow-up prefixes prompts to steer Gemini toward producing an image. The model requires seed tier or higher.

Added `gemini-search` so callers can request Google Search-grounded answers without supplying the search tool themselves. Follow-up changes corrected the Vertex AI tool format and model resolution, and adjusted authentication initialization.

Added `deepseek` as a seed-tier text model with tool support and aliases for DeepSeek V3.1.

highlights.title: Nano Banana image generation
highlights.text: Use `nanobanana` to generate an image from a prompt or edit one using reference image URLs. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nanobanana).

highlights.title: Gemini with search grounding
highlights.text: Ask `gemini-search` questions that need current information without adding the Google Search tool yourself. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini-search).

highlights.title: DeepSeek V3.1 added
highlights.text: Use the seed-tier `deepseek` text model for conversations and tool-calling requests. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek).

highlights.title: A language tutor model
highlights.text: Practice a language with `chickytutor`, a text-only tutor available without signing in. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=chickytutor).
